rationale: The massing reads as one dominant bar with a corner notch and a lower secondary base, so the primary gesture is legible in all views. The hierarchy is generally clear, though the notch/terrace conditions add some visual complexity. The form does not rely only on stair-step massing, but the silhouette still has a noticeable stepped/terraced quality. Void logic is present only as a small corner cut rather than a strong courtyard, undercut, or ground-level public void. The model appears mostly coherent and not excessively clipped, though the overlap between the base plate and the bar creates some ambiguity in a few views. Precedent resonance is decent with terrace-ribbon and sectional housing cues, but it stays closer to a generic bar-with-terrace logic than to the more articulate torqued or courtyard precedents.
warnings: Void/public ground logic is weak; the notch reads more like subtraction than a spatially usable opening.
Some views suggest the lower plate and upper bar are very close in depth, creating mild overlap ambiguity.
Terracing is present but not yet resolved into a stronger sectional move.
